entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: 340-aa query matches reviewed bacterial enzymes at 66–67% identity and 99.7% coverage; assignment is homology-supported.
Catalyzes NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation of 4-phospho-L-aspartate to L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde; EC 1.2.1.11.
Pfam domains Semialdhyde_dh (PF01118) and Semialdhyde_dhC (PF02774) detected.

entities.name: L-aspartate semialdehyde formation
observations: Reaction: 4-phospho-L-aspartate + NADPH + H+ → L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + phosphate + NADP+ (Rhea RHEA:24284).

entities.name: Aspartate-family amino acid biosynthesis
observations: Aspartate-semialdehyde formation is a shared intermediate step toward lysine, methionine, and threonine biosynthesis.
